_readme: THE config file — everything you might switch lives here. (1) Switch page: set pageId (or igUsername) + a FRESH metaUserToken (Graph API Explorer) and push; the agent mints the new page's permanent token on the next run and saves it to pageAccessToken automatically. (2) pageAccessToken: permanent page token — posting keeps working even after metaUserToken expires (page tokens never expire). (3) Pause everything: set autoPost to false (the GitHub Actions runner reads it live; force runs still work). (4) Schedule: slots + timezone (currently ONE post per day at 06:00 EAT). (5) IG catch-up window after slot time: graceMinutes (240 = the same 4-hour window Biblia Tafsiri Mbalimbali posts reliably with; past it that day's IG is skipped — the force button rescues it manually, posting just the IG half). (6) Mutual rescue: 'siblings' lists the pages this agent watches — any landed run here dispatches a sibling whose IG half is due but has no landed run of its own (token: dispatchToken in this file — already configured).
